items.name: Sunfire Aegis

passives.name: Immolate
passives.desc: Deal 16-25 (+0.8% bonus HP) magic/s to nearby enemies. 130% vs monsters, 175-250% vs minions. Stacks to 4 (+11%/stack = 44% max).

passives.name: Flametouch
passives.desc: At max Immolate stacks, autos burn enemies for 50% Immolate damage over 3s.

items.when_to_build: Default first item for tanks
items.why_to_build: Immolate clears waves; stacking damage adds up in extended fights

items.name: Thornmail

passives.name: Thorns
passives.desc: When struck by auto, deal 20 (+6% armor)(+2% HP) magic damage to attacker.

passives.name: Entwine
passives.desc: Being struck or dealing damage inflicts 50% Grievous Wounds for 3s.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has 2+ auto-attack carries
items.why_to_build: Highest armor + anti-heal + reflect damage

items.name: Frozen Heart

passives.name: Winter's Caress
passives.desc: Reduce attack speed of nearby enemies by 15%.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has multiple AS-reliant champs
items.why_to_build: AS reduction aura cripples attack speed carries

items.name: Warmog's Armor

passives.name: Warmog's Heart
passives.desc: Regen 2.5% max HP/s when out of combat for 6s. Requires 1100 bonus HP to activate.

items.when_to_build: Extended sieges; need to heal between fights without recalling
items.why_to_build: 800 HP is highest single item; out-of-combat regen = infinite sustain

items.name: Force of Nature

passives.name: Absorb
passives.desc: Taking magic damage grants stacks (max 5). At 5 stacks: +15% MS and 20% magic damage reduction.

passives.name: Base
passives.desc: +5% movement speed.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has heavy sustained AP damage (Brand, Swain)
items.why_to_build: Highest MR + magic damage reduction at stacks + MS

items.name: Randuin's Omen

passives.name: Rock Solid
passives.desc: Reduce incoming auto-attack damage by up to 20% (scales with bonus HP).

actives.name: Humility
actives.desc: Slow nearby enemies by 55% for 2s. 60s CD.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has crit marksmen
items.why_to_build: Rock Solid + active slow counters crit carries

items.name: Dead Man's Plate

passives.name: Momentum
passives.desc: Moving generates stacks (max 100). At 100, next auto deals 40-100 bonus magic damage + slow 50% for 1s.

passives.name: Base
passives.desc: +5% movement speed.

items.when_to_build: Need mobility to roam/engage
items.why_to_build: Momentum gives burst + slow for catching targets; MS for roaming

items.name: Heartsteel

passives.name: Colossal Consumption
passives.desc: Charge for 3s near champions. Charged auto deals 6% max HP bonus magic damage and permanently grants HP based on target's max HP. 30s CD per target.

items.when_to_build: Game will go late; champion benefits from infinite HP scaling
items.why_to_build: Only infinite HP scaling item; synergizes with HP-scaling abilities

items.name: Amaranth's Twinguard

passives.name: Prism
passives.desc: In champion combat, gain stacking %armor and %MR (max 20% each) over 4s.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has heavy mixed damage (AD + AP threats)
items.why_to_build: Only item giving both armor + MR that scales in combat

items.name: Hollow Radiance

passives.name: Deathfire
passives.desc: Immolate variant dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. Ability hits trigger burst of bonus damage.

items.when_to_build: Need Immolate effect + MR (vs AP heavy)
items.why_to_build: MR version of Sunfire; Immolate + ability burst for AP-heavy games

items.name: Kaenic Rookern

passives.name: Magebane
passives.desc: Gain a magic damage shield that regenerates after not taking magic damage for a period.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has burst AP (Annie, Syndra, Veigar)
items.why_to_build: Magic shield blocks first AP rotation; highest MR with shield

items.name: Abyssal Mask

passives.name: Unmake
passives.desc: Nearby CC'd enemy champions take 10% increased magic damage from all sources.

items.when_to_build: Team is AP-heavy and you provide CC
items.why_to_build: 10% magic damage amp benefits AP teammates; your CC enables it

items.name: Iceborn Gauntlet

passives.name: Spellblade
passives.desc: After ability, next auto creates slow zone dealing 100% base AD + 10% bonus HP bonus magic damage. Slow 30% for 2s. 1.5s CD.

items.when_to_build: Tank that needs slow + Spellblade damage
items.why_to_build: AoE slow zone prevents enemies from kiting; tankiest Spellblade

items.name: Dawnshroud

passives.name: Duskbringer
passives.desc: When you become CC'd or CC an enemy champion, deal magic damage to nearby enemies.

items.when_to_build: Provide lots of CC; need mixed resistances
items.why_to_build: AoE damage on CC procs adds teamfight damage from tank role

items.name: Mantle of the Twelfth Hour

passives.name: Sentinel
passives.desc: When you CC an enemy champion, grant a shield to the nearest lowest-HP ally.

items.when_to_build: Need to protect a carry while engaging
items.why_to_build: CC-triggered ally shield protects carries during your engage

items.name: Radiant Virtue

passives.name: Guiding Light
passives.desc: Casting ultimate heals nearby allies over time and increases their damage.

items.when_to_build: Teamfight-oriented; impactful AoE ultimate
items.why_to_build: Ult-triggered team heal turns your engage into a team sustain tool

items.name: Unending Despair

passives.name: Despair
passives.desc: In champion combat, periodically drain nearby enemies dealing magic damage and healing yourself.

items.when_to_build: Extended teamfights; need sustain as tank
items.why_to_build: Periodic drain keeps you alive in prolonged fights

items.name: Overlord's Bloodmail

passives.name: Vehemence
passives.desc: Below 50% HP, gain HP regen based on max HP.

items.when_to_build: Pure HP stacking build
items.why_to_build: 800 HP + regen below 50%; pairs with Heartsteel/Warmog's

items.name: Winter's Approach

passives.name: Awe
passives.desc: Gain bonus HP equal to 5% mana.

passives.name: Mana Charge
passives.desc: Abilities grant mana, stacking. Transforms into Fimbulwinter at 360 stacks.

items.when_to_build: Tank that uses mana; need scaling survivability
items.why_to_build: Fimbulwinter transform gives immobilize-triggered shield

items.name: Maw of Malmortius

passives.name: Lifeline
passives.desc: Taking magic damage that would reduce below 35% HP grants magic damage shield + 10% omnivamp for 5s. 60s CD.

items.when_to_build: AD carry/fighter facing AP burst
items.why_to_build: Only AD+MR+shield item; Lifeline saves vs AP burst

items.name: Chempunk Chainsword

passives.name: Hackshorn
passives.desc: Physical damage inflicts 40% Grievous Wounds for 3s.

items.when_to_build: Need AD anti-heal but not crit (bruiser)
items.why_to_build: AD bruiser anti-heal option; but stats are mediocre

items.name: Immortal Shieldbow

passives.name: Lifeline
passives.desc: Taking damage below 35% HP grants shield + bonus AD + omnivamp for 3s. 60s CD.

items.when_to_build: Need crit + anti-burst insurance
items.why_to_build: Lifeline shield saves from assassin burst; crit + AD for DPS

items.name: Protector's Vow

passives.name: Pledge
passives.desc: Bind to ally. Redirect damage from bound ally to yourself. Gain MS toward bound ally when they're low HP.

items.when_to_build: Need to protect a specific carry
items.why_to_build: Damage redirect keeps carry alive; MS lets you peel faster

items.name: Yordle Trap

passives.name: Trap Layer
passives.desc: Placing wards also spawns a trap. Enemies stepping on trap are slowed and revealed.

items.when_to_build: Need vision control + zone denial
items.why_to_build: Free traps from wards add zone control and enemy tracking

items.name: Zeke's Convergence

passives.name: Conduit
passives.desc: Bind to ally. When you cast ultimate, empower bound ally's attacks with bonus magic damage burn for 8s.

items.when_to_build: Your ADC benefits from attack speed and on-hit
items.why_to_build: Ult-empowered ally damage is free DPS for carries

items.name: Ardent Censer

passives.name: Sanctify
passives.desc: Shielding or healing an ally grants them 10-30% bonus AS and 10-30 magic damage on-hit for 6s.

items.when_to_build: ADC is auto-attack dependent
items.why_to_build: Best enchanter item; amplifies carry's DPS through your shields/heals

items.name: Harmonic Echo

passives.name: Harmonics
passives.desc: Moving/casting builds charges to 100. At full, next heal/shield on ally also heals nearest wounded ally for bonus amount.

items.when_to_build: Team needs frequent AoE healing in fights
items.why_to_build: Healing bounce is free extra healing; charges fast in teamfights

items.name: Staff of Flowing Waters

passives.name: Rapids
passives.desc: Shielding or healing an ally grants both of you bonus AP and AH for 4s.

items.when_to_build: ADC is AP (Ziggs/Veigar bot) or team has double AP
items.why_to_build: Double AP buff to you + ally; better than Ardent when carry is AP

items.name: Redemption

actives.name: Redemption
actives.desc: Target area after 2.5s delay: heal allies in zone + deal true damage to enemies. Global range. 120s CD.

items.when_to_build: Teamfight-heavy game; need AoE heal from any range
items.why_to_build: Global range AoE heal; can be used even while dead

items.name: Knight's Vow

passives.name: Pledge
passives.desc: Bind to ally. Redirect 12% of damage they take to you. Heal for 8% of bound ally's damage dealt to champions. Gain MS toward bound ally.

items.when_to_build: Carry needs protection from consistent damage
items.why_to_build: Damage redirect + heal from ally's damage keeps both alive

items.name: Imperial Mandate

passives.name: Coordinate
passives.desc: Immobilizing or slowing an enemy marks them. Allies consuming the mark deal 40-100 bonus magic damage + gain 20% MS for 2s.

items.when_to_build: Team has follow-up damage for marks
items.why_to_build: Mark system adds team damage but stats are mediocre

items.name: Boots of Speed
items.when_to_build: First recall buy
items.why_to_build: Cheapest MS; builds into all boots

items.name: Berserker's Greaves

passives.name: Enhanced Movement
passives.desc: +40 movement speed (flat, not in stats).

items.when_to_build: Auto-attack champion
items.why_to_build: Highest AS from boots; standard ADC boots

items.name: Boots of Dynamism

passives.name: Adaptive Force
passives.desc: +10 Adaptive Force (= 5 AD or 10 AP).

items.when_to_build: Want raw damage from boots
items.why_to_build: Free adaptive force; great on snowballing champs

items.name: Boots of Mana

passives.name: Mana Flow
passives.desc: +100% base mana regen. +8% magic penetration.

items.when_to_build: AP champion that needs mana sustain + magic pen
items.why_to_build: AP + magic pen + mana regen from boots; best mage boots

items.name: Gluttonous Greaves

passives.name: Omnivamp
passives.desc: +8% Physical Vamp.

items.when_to_build: Need sustain from boots; AD carry/fighter
items.why_to_build: Vamp from boots frees up item slot for damage

items.name: Ionian Boots of Lucidity
items.when_to_build: Need maximum AH; not threatened by specific damage type
items.why_to_build: AH from boots + reduced summoner spell CD

items.name: Mercury's Treads

passives.name: Tenacity
passives.desc: +30% Tenacity.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has heavy CC + AP damage
items.why_to_build: Tenacity reduces CC duration; MR reduces AP damage

items.name: Plated Steelcaps

passives.name: Block
passives.desc: Reduce damage from auto-attacks by 10%.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has 2+ auto-attack threats
items.why_to_build: 10% auto damage reduction stacks with armor

items.name: Stasis Enchant
items.when_to_build: Facing burst/dive comps; need a panic button
items.why_to_build: Best defensive enchant; counters burst combos and tower dives

items.name: Quicksilver Enchant

actives.name: Quicksilver Enchant
actives.desc: Remove all crowd control effects and gain 50% MS for 1.5s. 90s CD.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has critical CC (Malphite ult, Ashe arrow)
items.why_to_build: Only item-based CC cleanse; essential vs heavy CC

items.name: Veil Enchant

actives.name: Veil Enchant
actives.desc: Gain a spell shield that blocks the next enemy ability. 40s CD. Shield lasts until broken.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has single critical CC/ability to block
items.why_to_build: Proactive spell shield prevents picks

items.name: Protobelt Enchant

actives.name: Protobelt Enchant
actives.desc: Dash forward and fire 7 bolts dealing 75-145 magic damage. 40s CD.

items.when_to_build: Immobile mage needing gap close
items.why_to_build: Dash + damage combo for engage or escape

items.name: Galeforce

actives.name: Galeforce
actives.desc: Dash in target direction, firing 3 missiles at lowest HP nearby enemy dealing 75-150 magic damage. 60s CD.

items.when_to_build: ADC needing dash for repositioning
items.why_to_build: Only ADC dash enchant; missiles add burst

items.name: Goredrinker

actives.name: Goredrinker
actives.desc: AoE slash dealing 15% AD physical damage to nearby enemies. Heal 10% missing HP per champion hit. 40s CD.

items.when_to_build: Melee bruiser/fighter in teamfights
items.why_to_build: AoE damage + missing HP heal in clustered fights

items.name: Stoneplate Enchant

actives.name: Stoneplate Enchant
actives.desc: Gain a shield equal to 100 +100% bonus HP for 3s. During shield, deal Immolate damage. 60s CD.

items.when_to_build: Tank engaging into 3+ enemies
items.why_to_build: Massive shield for frontline engage; Immolate burst

items.name: Locket Enchant

actives.name: Locket Enchant
actives.desc: Shield nearby allies for 75-180 + 20% AP for 2.5s. 60s CD.

items.when_to_build: Support/tank protecting team from AoE burst
items.why_to_build: Team-wide shield counters AoE damage

items.name: Stridebreaker

actives.name: Stridebreaker
actives.desc: Short dash + AoE slow (60% for 2s) to nearby enemies. 15s CD.

items.when_to_build: Melee needing to stick to targets
items.why_to_build: Short CD dash + slow for gap closing

items.name: Dream Maker

actives.name: Dream Maker
actives.desc: Healing/shielding an ally empowers their next 3 attacks with bonus magic damage + heals you. 6s CD.

items.when_to_build: Enchanter support buffing auto-attack carry
items.why_to_build: Adds on-hit damage and self-sustain to heal/shield pattern

items.name: Glorious Enchant

actives.name: Glorious Enchant
actives.desc: Gain 15% MS bonus for 4s. Approaching enemy champions increases MS to 60% for 2.5s. 60s CD.

items.when_to_build: Engage tank needing to reach backline
items.why_to_build: Speed boost for engaging; cheaper alternative to other enchants

items.name: Spectral Sickle

passives.name: Tribute
passives.desc: Attacks on champions/turrets grant bonus gold. At 500g earned, upgrades to Black Mist Scythe (+3 wards).

items.when_to_build: Ranged support that pokes
items.why_to_build: Gold generation through poking; evolves into ward item

items.name: Relic Shield

passives.name: Spoils of War
passives.desc: Execute low HP minions and share gold with nearby ally. At 500g earned, upgrades to Bulwark of the Mountain (+3 wards).

items.when_to_build: Melee support
items.why_to_build: Gold generation through minion execution; evolves into ward item

items.name: Shimmering Spark

passives.name: Arcane
passives.desc: Nearby minion deaths generate gold. At 500g earned, upgrades (+3 wards).

items.when_to_build: Passive laning support
items.why_to_build: Gold from nearby minion deaths without attacking

items.name: Ring of Revelation

passives.name: Mana Covenant
passives.desc: Nearby ally champion gains bonus mana regen. At 500g quest, upgrades (+3 wards).

items.when_to_build: Supporting mana-hungry ADC
items.why_to_build: Mana support + quest gold generation

items.name: Sheen
items.notes: Spellblade: after ability, next auto deals 100% base AD bonus physical

items.name: Bramble Vest
items.notes: Thorns: reflect damage + 40% GW when struck

items.name: Hexdrinker
items.notes: Lifeline: magic shield at low HP
